review_kind: independent actual-source and completed native ARM build review
scope: Classic seven-bit interrupt-driven I2C master for twelve source-qualified families, five existing IP versions and seventeen controller slots; unchanged L012 blocking backend included as a regression row.
clean_status: not_run_at_main_acceptance; a separate final-package clean supplement is required

timing_and_configure.boundaries: Timing derive through end of configure; excludes preceding pull helper

pull_timing_and_configure.boundaries: Starts at fn pull(enabled: bool) -> Pull; ends immediately before // Each command starts from the complete typed CR baseline. This includes the same 2004-byte Timing/configure slice plus the unchanged 84-byte pull helper and following blank line.

actual_code_review.result: The only source delta is one crate-private method; removing it reproduces all old bytes. Zero attempts, forbidden reset policy, absent reset and disabled gate reject before reset writes. Exactly one assert and one release RMW preserve neighboring bits in short critical sections. Each acknowledgement loop is separately bounded and outside those sections. Release is attempted after unconfirmed assertion and cannot erase assertion failure. No APBEN key, gate write or peripheral-local MMIO occurs.

Explicit family-to-IP and instance whitelist covers 12 families/five versions/17 slots. Exactly one GLOBAL link resolves uniquely by name; numeric aliases, other owners and other sources are rejected. Reset admission resolves actual SYSCTRL word-offset/bit/range overlap, rejects shared groups and requires active-low reset. L012 retains old numeric impl_instance invocation and separate unchanged driver selection/body.

AsyncGuard holds an ordinary mutable I2c borrow. Caller operations/cursors remain in the future; static State has only AtomicWaker and two flags. No caller, future, pin or DR-destination pointer is published. Inactive ISR masks and returns before I2C MMIO; armed SI=0 is spurious and remains armed; armed SI=1 masks/inactivates and wakes after the section without CR/STAT/DR mutation.

Every poll registers first, then masks/inactivates, reads SI, arms/enables only if clear, and rereads SI before Pending. Commands are outside repeated polling and therefore are not replayed by spurious task wake. No ordinary byte transition clears NVIC pending. Pending clears only after checked reset/configuration with the IRQ masked.

Retained Active is retired before input validation. Ordinary invalid address/empty read and empty operation behavior is preserved. Same-direction operations share address phases; only direction changes issue repeated START; adjacent reads NACK only the final byte. Error states precede expected-state acceptance, including successful expected58. Typed complete CR baselines set DR/control before SI clear, preserving zero L010/L011 GPIO selectors.

Normal STOP rechecks fresh held status and sets stop_attempted before STO. Active retirement independently recognizes exactly 38/68/78/B0, the ten held-master codes, and separately00. SI0/slave/F8/unknown never authorizes STOP. Failed normal/cleanup STOP cannot issue a second STO. Local completion requires STO0 and SI0; unexpected SI becomes Bus or Arbitration. Explicit finish retires before choosing Faulted > observed Arbitration > original error, then disarms the guard. Drop is only cancellation/unwind fallback.

One typed EN0/STA0/AA0/SI1 baseline write and BRREN0 precede one bounded combined readback loop. Each iteration reads CR once and BRREN once, checks EN/STA/AA/FLT and optional zero selectors, separately STO0, and BRREN0. SI/STAT/line levels are not invented retirement proofs. Failure latches static Faulted. Successful local retirement records NeedsReinitialize.

Both constructors validate then atomically fence old IRQ/check sticky fault before Flex construction or any pin mutation. Inherited state is disable-only with no STOP. Closed gate uses central Readback::None under a short section and bounded polling outside it. Checked reset is called outside an outer critical section only after confirmed disable/STO0. Its every error latches Faulted and returns before I2C MMIO. One reset-default loop precedes unchanged configure order; one configure loop also verifies gate/reset state. Reuse never performs an EN-toggle cursor-reset shortcut or retries abandoned operations.

Async configuration retires Active first, preserves old cached config on invalid/busy candidate and leaves NeedsReinitialize disabled; valid high-line candidate uses checked reset/configuration then commits. Faulted forbids later local/gate MMIO, including Drop/reconstruction. Async Drop dispatches Idle disable-only, Active retirement, NeedsReinitialize no local command, and Faulted no local/gate writes, rechecking a newly arising fault before gating. Blocking teardown and algorithm retain their old behavior behind the common fault/IRQ fence.

public_contract_review: The documented SI/no-deadline, finite synchronous sample, forgotten-input exception, STOP/error precedence, cancellation/target effects and sticky-fault boundaries agree with the reviewed source. Candidate wording is to be updated only administratively after this acceptance. No waveform, external bus repair, atomicity, retries or hardware validation is claimed.

bounded_work.notation: N is validated nonzero poll_limit; each bounded sample section is short, never an entire N-loop. Counts concern the new I2C path, not preexisting GPIO ownership internals.
bounded_work.idle: At most N CR samples, conditional STAT reads on SI, and sampled SCL/SDA checks. SI waits instead are asynchronous with no internal sample deadline.
bounded_work.stop: At most N CR samples, conditional STAT reads on SI; one STO command per retained Active allowance.
bounded_work.retirement: At most one N-sample STOP/error-clear loop plus one N-sample combined CR/BRREN loop. Fixed work is live CR/conditional STAT classification, optional one arbitration baseline release, conditional one STO request, optional post-failed-STOP CR/conditional STAT arbitration release, then one EN0/SI1 baseline and one BRREN0 write. No recursive retry or await.
bounded_work.central_reset: One gate read before writes; one assert RMW + at most N assert reads; one release RMW + at most N release reads. Both RMWs are short critical sections, reads outside.
bounded_work.reset_defaults: At most N samples each reading CR, BRREN and BRR once.
bounded_work.configuration: Fixed CR0, BRREN0, BRR divider, BRREN1, baseline CR writes. At most N samples each reading CR, BRREN, BRR, gate and reset once. Successful setup has one dedicated NVIC unpend.
bounded_work.constructor: An initially closed gate adds one central enable RMW and at most N gate samples. All constructors add one local-disable sequence/readback before reset. No legacy 100000-sample I2C gate helper is used.

resolved_source_prefix_error.finding: A rustfmt stdout filename header was accidentally prepended to classic.rs, yielding invalid Rust before the module documentation.
resolved_source_prefix_error.correction: Exactly the 80-byte invalid filename/blank-line prefix was removed before actual Cargo execution; the rejected source snapshot is retained as external review history.

four_failed_real_attempts.result: E0609: PA5 is excluded by the existing F002/F003 safe-pin policy.
After PB1 correction, real 16 KiB FLASH overflowed by 128 bytes.
F002 fallible startup saved 32 bytes; real FLASH still overflowed by 96 bytes.
Direct-error helper saved no additional bytes; real FLASH still overflowed by 96 bytes. That helper was reverted.

amendments_and_failures.accepted_route_correction: F002/F003 use existing safe PB1 SCL AF3 with PA6 SDA AF3; positions 6/19 and 8/23 respectively. Frozen design remains historical; this current-batch exception corrects a bonded route that the safe HAL intentionally excludes. No canonical route or debug-pad policy changed.
amendments_and_failures.accepted_startup_correction: F002 alone uses existing try_init(default).unwrap_or_else(halt) in each binary. Same successful initialization and terminal halt behavior; no driver Drop is claimed. Other chips keep original init.
amendments_and_failures.final_size_policy: Example release opt-level z, LTO true, one codegen unit, real chip memory. Four ordinary API patterns, buffers and loop remain. Ineffective direct-error duplicate was removed. No substituted chip, enlarged memory or runtime algorithm change.

warning_review.classification: Existing RCC LSE constant emitters, present in prechange build.rs; no new I2C warning. Other reviewed rows have no compiler warnings.

main_source_gates.correspondence: Facts/checker/canonical input and module membership did not change after these gates. All final ELFs subsequently ran with the amended source. Final administrative provenance and packaging closure remain separate.
